functions.name: ProjectEntry

callGraph.callee:
["flex w-full items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] hover:bg-white/5",
                ((w.primary && currentWorktree === "") || currentWorktree === w.branch) ? "text-[var(--color-text-1)]" : "text-[var(--color-text-3)]"].join

[
          "h-[6px] w-[6px] shrink-0 rounded-full",
          running ? "animate-pulse bg-[var(--color-success)] shadow-[0_0_5px_var(--color-success)]" : "bg-[var(--color-text-3)]/50",
        ].join

[
                        "flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-[7px] text-left text-xs font-medium transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-micro)]",
                        active
                          ? "bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.07)] text-[var(--color-text-1)] shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]"
                          : "text-[var(--color-text-2)] hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.04)] hover:text-[var(--color-text-1)]",
                      ].join

functions.name: Button
params:
{
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
  type = "button",
  loading = false,
  icon,
  disabled,
  children,
  ...rest
}

callGraph.callee:
[
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-md font-medium select-none",
        "transition-[background-color,color,border-color,filter,transform] duration-[var(--motion-micro)] ease-[var(--motion-ease)]",
        "active:scale-[0.97]",
        "outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-role-design)_40%,transparent)]",
        "disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:active:scale-100",
        VARIANT[variant],
        SIZE[size],
        className,
      ].join

[
        "flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg",
        "border border-dashed border-[var(--color-border-subtle)] px-6 py-8 text-center",
        className,
      ].join

[
        "w-full rounded-md bg-[var(--color-bg-surface)] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--color-text-1)]",
        "border border-[var(--color-border-subtle)] outline-none",
        "transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-micro)] ease-[var(--motion-ease)]",
        "focus:border-[var(--color-border-strong)]",
        "placeholder:text-[var(--color-text-3)] disabled:opacity-50",
        className,
      ].join

[
        "inline-flex items-center rounded-[3.5px] border border-[var(--color-border-strong)]",
        "bg-[var(--color-bg-raised)] px-1.5 text-[9px] leading-[15px] text-[var(--color-text-3)] font-mono shadow-[var(--shadow-raised)]",
        className,
      ].join

functions.name: Popover
params:
{
  open,
  onClose,
  anchor,
  children,
  align = "left",
  className = "",
  role,
}

callGraph.callee:
[
            "absolute top-full z-50 mt-1 min-w-[180px] rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border-subtle)]",
            "bg-[var(--color-bg-raised)] p-1 shadow-[var(--shadow-raised)]",
            align === "right" ? "right-0" : "left-0",
            className,
          ].join

[
        "w-full rounded-md bg-[var(--color-bg-surface)] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--color-text-1)]",
        "border border-[var(--color-border-subtle)] outline-none",
        "transition-colors duration-[var(--motion-micro)] ease-[var(--motion-ease)]",
        "focus:border-[var(--color-border-strong)] disabled:opacity-50",
        className,
      ].join

[
          "w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-3 pt-2 text-[12px] text-[var(--color-text-1)] outline-none",
          "placeholder:text-[var(--color-text-3)]",
          expanded ? "h-32" : "h-16",
        ].join

[
            "pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 z-[70] -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap",
            "rounded-md border border-[var(--color-border-subtle)] bg-[var(--color-bg-raised)] px-2 py-1",
            "text-[11px] text-[var(--color-text-1)] shadow-[var(--shadow-raised)]",
            side === "top" ? "bottom-full mb-1.5" : "top-full mt-1.5",
          ].join
